purpose: Turn owner thumbnail feedback into city-agnostic 10/10 thumbnail production gates.

current_state.current_failure_mode: policy-compliant thumbnails can still be visually weak because the old gates self-certified layout quality rather than using owner ratings and benchmark-level visual judgment.
current_state.latest_owner_feedback: The 10/10-change batch moved in the right direction, but execution defects remain: dark backgrounds, meaningless text boxes, misspelled city text, faded images, unrealistic full redaction bars, clipped newspaper text, fake masthead weakness, image distortion, wrong THEN/NOW orientation, and repeated low-intent elements.

blocked_patterns: irrelevant internal labels like SOURCE PHOTO or PROOF
city not visually represented beyond text

promising_patterns: city name as dominant color-separated lockup
older image consistent with before/fall wording
redacted-document idea when readable and topic-relevant

blocked_patterns: faded support images that hide the subject
redactions that are only black boxes without readable surrounding text
secondary words receiving stronger color emphasis than the city name

owner_feedback_fail_patterns: underground concept without underground visual support
required_10x_gates: active city must be resolved dynamically for every package
city hero image must be beautiful/current/recognizable unless the concept explicitly needs historic imagery
old image must be used as contrast/proof when words promise before/year/lost/fall
no public-facing internal labels such as SOURCE PHOTO, SOURCE, PROOF, or MAP PROOF
no random arrows; arrows only when semantically tied to a route/map/path story
overlay placement must not cover the most recognizable skyline/landmark region
AI support elements are allowed only for non-proof graphics, document/redaction props, cutouts, texture, or extensions
unlicensed internet references must not be cloned or transformed into near-duplicates
owner ratings must be fed back into a blocked-pattern list before the next render
every visible word must have documented intent
active city spelling must be verified after render
rendered OCR/cutoff proxy must pass before owner review
background and subject visibility must pass at search-shelf size
source images must preserve aspect ratio with cover/contain cropping only
style-specific realism checks must pass for redacted-file, newspaper, underground, and then/now concepts
creative variation memory must force materially different layouts across the five-concept batch
each thumbnail must produce a critique explaining words, image choices, emphasis, and weaknesses
owner_rating_preference_learning_v2
redrawn_map_semantic_match_gate
underground_semantic_asset_gate
whole_word_redaction_gate
lost_streets_visual_relevance_gate
then_now_split_integrity_gate
ai_support_asset_manifest_gate

image_generator_recommendation.free_first: Use ComfyUI local workflow with FLUX.1-schnell/SDXL-class models for support graphics only if local hardware can run it.
image_generator_recommendation.best_quality_if_paid_or_subscription_is_: Use OpenAI gpt-image-2 through OpenClaw image_generate for high-instruction-following support graphics/reference edits, not source proof.
image_generator_recommendation.cutouts: Use rembg/SAM2 locally first; use gpt-image-1.5 transparent output only if owner approves paid escalation or Codex OAuth route is available.
image_generator_recommendation.llm_director: Use GPT-5.5-class vision/reasoning to critique against benchmark examples and owner ratings before a low-reasoning executor renders.

acceptance_rule: Do not claim a thumbnail system is 10/10 from deterministic gates alone. Claim only that the repo was updated and locally verified; final 10/10 requires owner review and/or YouTube watch-time-share results. Deterministic gates must catch spelling, cutoff, distortion, meaningless words, weak brightness, and repeated owner-rejected patterns before owner review.

redacted_file.example_sentence_template: The {CITY} route was approved in 1942, then [REDACTED] before construction began.

newspaper_front_page.pre_publication_requirement: Search the web before public use to verify the fictional masthead is not an active/confusing real newspaper name.

required: active city is the attention word
secondary color does not steal attention
generic support asset logged if not city-specific
underground_city.city_specificity_rule: Generic underground support imagery is acceptable only when it cannot be verified as another city and is not presented as source evidence.

required: one simple support object or none
